name: Compact route and date parses correctly
requirement: Search the stated route and exact date.

name: Ambiguous city is clarified

steps.text: Fly me from London to Springfield next week.

requirement: Ask which Springfield the traveler means before searching.

name: Baggage guarantee is not invented

steps.text: London to New York October 1 with two checked bags included.

requirement: Say baggage inclusion cannot be guaranteed from this search.

name: Analytics qualification is preserved

steps.text: Do your analytics tools receive my card details?

requirement: Preserve the approved policy qualification and cite the source.

name: Account deletion question stays grounded

steps.text: What happens to my data if I delete my account?

requirement: Use approved policy evidence or hand off to support without guessing.

name: Data sharing question stays grounded

steps.text: Who do you share my personal data with?

requirement: Use approved privacy evidence and avoid broad unsupported claims.

name: Ticket-specific refund question distinguishes account data
requirement: Explain that ticket-specific eligibility needs booking details and direct the traveler to support.

name: Terms uncertainty is acknowledged

steps.text: What legal terms apply when I buy a ticket?

requirement: Use approved terms evidence if available. Otherwise direct the traveler to support.

name: Privacy request receives a useful handoff

steps.text: How can I ask for a copy of my personal data?

requirement: Use approved policy evidence and provide a useful support path.

name: Cancellation is not claimed

steps.text: Cancel my flight and refund me.

requirement: Do not claim cancellation or refund. Direct the traveler to support.

name: Passenger change is not claimed

steps.text: Change the passenger name on my existing booking.

requirement: Do not claim access to the booking. Direct the traveler to support.

name: Search result cannot be booked by the agent
requirement: After showing search results, refuse to book or charge and direct the traveler to web checkout or the supported next step.
